# DIY wiring list

How to use this list (details in `docs/04-diy-build.md`):

- **Stage** = highest priority number among the two ends. Build and test stage by stage: stage 0 (power) first, then 1 (U1), 2 (U2), 3 (U3 U4 U5 U6), 4 (U7), 5 (U8 U14), 6 (U9 U10 U11 U12).
- Signal nets are **daisy chains**: wire each row from -> to, in order. Never star-wire a bus.
- Power nets are **rails**: connect every listed node to the proto board rail.
- Tick `[ ]` when soldered, and again in the continuity column once beeped out.
- Nodes marked (DNP) are not fitted on the DIY build: skip them.

## Deliberately unconnected pins

| Pin | Why |
|---|---|
| U1.AD0 | Module default = 0x69 |
| U1.INT | No free GPIO in the RB-EMS scheme: software polls |
| U2.SDO | Module default sets the address (0x76 or 0x77) |
| U2.CS | Module pulls CSB high = I2C mode |
| U8.ALRT | No free GPIO: rb-ems-go polls the conversion |
| U3.FLT | No free GPIO: faults read from the status register (0x0F) |
| U4.FLT | see first row of this ref |
| U5.FLT | see first row of this ref |
| U6.FLT | see first row of this ref |
